boards.title: Your First Weekend at Messiah University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A calm first-weekend route through campus places, student resources, and recurring activities.

cards.entity_name: Kim S. Phipps Admissions and Welcome Center
cards.title: Begin at the Phipps Welcome Center
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Get oriented
cards.notes: Use this first stop to confirm your campus bearings, then choose two nearby destinations to walk to before settling into your evening.
cards.short_summary: Start from Messiah’s named admissions and welcome destination.
cards.evidence_claim: Messiah identifies the Admissions Office as located in the Kim S. Phipps Admissions and Welcome Center.
cards.access_notes: Consult Messiah Admissions for current visitor arrangements.

cards.title: Learn the rhythm at Lottie Nelson
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Campus meal
cards.notes: Make your first dining stop practical: review the posted meal options, locate the entry point, and note what will make future meals easier.
cards.short_summary: A first meal at Messiah’s main dining hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Lottie Nelson Dining Hall is Messiah University's main dining hall and is located on the upper level of the Eisenhower Campus Center.
cards.access_notes: Check Dining Services for current menus, hours, and payment arrangements.

cards.title: Locate the Union Café
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Student-union stop
cards.notes: Walk through the Larsen Student Union, find the café, and keep it in mind for a quick daytime meal between classes or meetings.
cards.short_summary: Find an additional dining location inside the student union.
cards.evidence_claim: The Union Café is located on the first floor of the Larsen Student Union building.
cards.access_notes: Review Dining Services for current hours and payment options.

cards.title: Choose a future study spot at Murray
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · Study-space stop
cards.notes: Walk through the building, identify a quiet or collaborative area that suits you, and save the research-help contact details for later.
cards.short_summary: Turn a short library visit into a usable study plan.
cards.evidence_claim: Murray Library provides quiet and chat-friendly individual and group study places, plus librarian research help.
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s current hours before planning a longer study visit.

cards.title: See what is showing at Aughinbaugh
cards.subtitle: Saturday late morning · Art stop
cards.notes: Visit the current exhibition, then take a moment to read the gallery information and watch for a future talk or opening that fits your schedule.
cards.short_summary: A no-admission art stop with changing exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: The Aughinbaugh Gallery presents new exhibitions on a six-week basis and includes work by artists, faculty, and students.
cards.source_title: Mission — The Galleries at Messiah University
cards.access_notes: Messiah states that its galleries are free and open to the public; check the gallery contact page for current hours.

cards.title: Plan a look through the Oakes Museum
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Natural-history stop
cards.notes: Set aside time for the museum’s collections, then review the visitor page before a return visit so you can match your plan to public hours.
cards.short_summary: Explore a named museum in the Jordan Science Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Oakes Museum of Natural History is in Messiah’s Jordan Science Center and features natural-history exhibits and collections.
cards.source_title: School of Science, Engineering and Health Facilities
cards.access_notes: The museum lists public Saturday hours and paid adult admission; verify details before visiting.

cards.title: Take the Covered Bridge route
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Creekside walk
cards.notes: Use the bridge as a daylight waypoint on a campus walk, pause for the Yellow Breeches view, and return by established routes on campus.
cards.short_summary: A named bridge crossing the creek at the south end of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Messiah University describes its Covered Bridge as spanning the Yellow Breeches Creek at the south end of campus.
cards.access_notes: Stay on permitted routes and use daylight and weather-aware judgment.

cards.title: Get acquainted with Falcon Fitness
cards.subtitle: Saturday late afternoon · Recreation stop
cards.notes: Tour the facility if access allows, identify equipment or a class that interests you, and check the current entry rules before returning to work out.
cards.short_summary: A campus fitness facility with equipment and group exercise.
cards.evidence_claim: Messiah’s Falcon Fitness Center is a 14,000+ square-foot fitness facility with equipment and group exercise offerings.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current student access, waivers, and hours directly with Falcon Fitness Center.

cards.title: Check in with the Student Activities Board
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening · Campus-activity option
cards.notes: Look for a current SAB program that interests you, then save the organization contact so you can track future events without guessing at schedules.
cards.short_summary: Use Messiah’s student-programming organization to find a current event.
cards.evidence_claim: Messiah’s Student Activities Board provides the student body with a variety of events and activities.
cards.source_title: Campus Activities Clubs and Organizations at Messiah University
cards.access_notes: Programs vary; consult SAB’s current channels or Student Engagement for event details.

cards.title: Save chapel details for the week ahead
cards.subtitle: Sunday · Campus reflection
cards.notes: Review the current chapel schedule and choose an upcoming gathering that works for you, rather than assuming a service is scheduled this weekend.
cards.short_summary: Prepare for Messiah’s recurring campus worship program.
cards.evidence_claim: Messiah offers chapel gatherings on most Tuesday mornings, Tuesday evenings, and Thursday mornings during the semester.
cards.access_notes: Check Messiah’s chapel schedule for the most up-to-date dates, venues, and attendance details.
